name: ipv4
title: IPv4 addresses
description: Find lines containing dotted-decimal IPv4 addresses, with each octet from 0 to 255.
limitations: IPv4 only; no IPv6 or leading-zero octets. Conservative ASCII boundaries reject embedded tokens and a colon immediately before an address. Ports and CIDR suffixes are allowed. A dot immediately after the address is rejected, including sentence punctuation.

name: domains
title: Domain-shaped text
description: Find lines containing ASCII hostnames such as example.com or api.example.co.uk.
limitations: A heuristic, not DNS validation: requires a 2–63 letter final label. No Unicode or punycode TLDs, underscores, or single-label hosts. Punycode in other labels is accepted. Labels are limited to 63 characters; total hostname length is not checked. File names such as report.txt also match. A trailing root dot is accepted.
